note: One object per device family. The box, the centre and the design list are in the family's samples.json; the functions (validity rule, prior, metrics) are in the family's family.py. registry.py reads this file.

families.prior_model: Pozar coupled-line synthesis, Kirschning-Jansen coupled microstrip, Hammerstad open ends, Kobayashi dispersion

fidelity_tags.fine: Palace 0.16, mesh scale 1.0, order 2 (reference, nominal only)
